reasons: Deviation classification is correct: the clause has no cap on audit frequency, which fails the fallback's 'once per year' material term and edges toward the walk-away 'unlimited audits' position, notwithstanding that cost allocation (>5% discrepancy), independent mutually-agreed auditor and records-only scope already meet or beat the playbook.

Redline is a targeted, additive proviso to p0073 that inserts the once-per-twelve-months cap plus business-hours conduct and a confidentiality-bound auditor, without disturbing the favourable cost and auditor-selection terms — the smallest edit that reaches the playbook position.

The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is a phrasing mismatch only; the inserted text expressly says 'no more than one (1) such audit in any twelve (12) month period'. The 0.765 changed-character ratio reflects appended proviso length on a short clause, not a rewrite, and no original language was deleted.

Minor accuracy note (not disqualifying): the original 'permitted by Licensee within 30 days of ... a written request' is a deadline for Licensee to accommodate rather than a guaranteed 30 days' advance notice; the rationale/comment describe it as '30-day notice'. Consider tightening the comment or adding express advance-notice wording if notice becomes contentious.
Comment is concise, in the required voice, cites the playbook position and accurately states what changed and what was left alone.
